this is a far superior book tracking app to any others I've used. So easy to switch over from Goodreads and the user experience is far superior.
I love this app. It is my favorite bookish app. Its stats are amazing and help me organize my reading! Simple to use as well.
Great app which is constantly updated with new features. The maker of this app truly listens to what the users want changed or added.

I love & recommend StoryGraph for tracking what I read! User since 2022, never any issues (Android). Had paid subscription (allows you to get creative with custom tracking) and free version (which includes amazing features and no ads ever). I love setting reading Challenges, then watching my progress and viewing daily Reading Stats. It's easy to add and filter books in my To-Read Pile list. The monthly and annual Wrap-up Graphics are a beautiful recap of my reads. Tracking helps me read more!
I've been using Storygraph for a couple of years now and it's by far my favourite way of tracking my reading!

reviews.reply: Hi Shruti! I'm focusing on performance issues this month so hopefully you see an improvement soon!

reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic app. It's great being able to keep track of my reading and books I want to read. Love that I can track my audiobooks in minutes and that you can add editions yourself if they're not yet in their catalogue. The stats are amazing and being able to use tags to track anything I want is incredible. Also the team behind the app may be tiny but they are great at responding to questions and feedback. The app gets improved all the time based on what users want. All in all, I love it!
The best book tracking app I've ever used.

Best reading/book tracking app I've ever used. Super user-friendly & beautiful UI. The monthly reading wrapups are my favorite, and I love that you can generate a calendar with your stats! I also enjoy the challenges you can join or create.

I used to use Goodreads, then both Goodreads and StoryGraph, and now I just use StoryGraph. I enjoy the stats and the challenges. I love that the app is Black woman-owned, as opposed to Goodreads which is owned by Amazon. I can't recall any major issues with the app since I downloaded it over a year ago. It feels like the team is always thinking about ways to improve the app and make the app (and reading) more enjoyable for users. It's safe to say that I'm a happy customer!

I've been using StoryGraph for a couple of months now and love it! I switched from Goodreads and the data import worked seamlessly. Above all, I appreciate the flexibility it gives me in tracking my reading - I can edit reading dates, editions, tags, etc. Reading feels rewarding, especially thanks to the streak and buddy read feature. Development is based on the community's feedback and happens in a very transparent manner. Highly recommend!
I love this app. From the Reading Challenges feature to the graphs and giveaways. Everything has been great!
the developers listen to their user base and constantly update storygraph to reflect what users want. I've upgraded to plus membership because of how much I've enjoyed this app.
reviews.reply: Aww, that's awesome, charlie. Thank you!

reviews.text: I love this app for tracking which books I have read. it is so much better than good reads for showing nerds like me data associated with each book. there are also a ton of features that allow you to set reading challenges, and join other users challenges. the visual stimulation of lie and bar charts to show your reading journey is great. they even have a feature to create a graphic that summarizes your reading journey for the month into a picture formatted specifically for sharing on social.
A great app for tracking books. I love the monthly wrap up and collage

I've been a StoryGraph user for years now and it is the absolute best. Continuous improvements, unique features, as well as the kind and transparent communication from the small (amazing) team makes this app a must-have for me.
reviews.reply: Hello there, Tam! Thank you so much! Thank you for being one of our earliest users! 🥰

reviews.text: I use this app to track my reading. I love analytics, and look forward to the end of every month when I can see a summary of my reading. It's easy to track both physical and audio books. Other great features are book giveaways, buddy reads, & custom recommedations. My only complaint is the app can lag slightly at times, and I didn't find the interface to be 100% intuitive at first. But in my opinion, this is not worth removing a full star, especially when I know the dev team is a 1 woman show 😊
reviews.reply: Hello Ava! Thank you for the review and rating. I'll definitely be working on the issues that you've raised here. :-D

reviews.text: I've literally never been able to consistently track my reading until I downloaded this app a few years ago. I love the stats and the app works great

This is not a app you use to read books. But it IS a app that you use to keep track of all the things! TBR, DNF, Read, Owned Books....so so much more. It FAR exceeds what Goodreads could ever try to do. It's updated regularly and when there are hiccups this team FIXES them. Everything you want is here and if it isn't there's a good chance it will be soon. They listen to us and what we want/need and make it happen. I LOVE it.
Hands down the best book related app out there. Such a breath of fresh air to actually have support and new features constantly as opposed to some other stagnant apps.

I've been using StoryGraph for a few years now and couldn't be happier with my switch from Goodreads. To name a few favorites - I love being able to adjust journal entries when I miss a few days of recording and need to catch up, being able to switch between editions (audio, digital, paperback, different translations, etc.)... and most of all, I love love love the monthly and year-end Wrapup infographics!!

Excellent and very easy to use. I love that I can change the edition of the book so it matches exactly the version I read. I also love how relevant the recommended books are to what I actually read and enjoy being able to visualize all my reading stats through different types of graphs and charts. Overall, A+!
Just really the best to get your stats, organise your shelves and keep you on your toes with your reading with streaks! Less of a social app and more a true book tracking app. Highly recommend.
Great way to track books you're reading and want to read.

Love this app! Wonderful way to track my reading. My favorite part is the Buddy Read. The Buddy Read allows you to read with your friends but at your own speed. You can leave comments or have discussions while you read but it's always labeled with a page number and hidden until you're ready to read it. I also love that the Giveaways don't automatically add the book to your TBR like Goodreads does. Goodereads totally messed up my TBR with that feature.

Love love love this app! Functionality is so much better and more flexible than other similar and more popular reading tracker apps. I genuinely think that keeping track of my reading on Storygraph has made me a more habitual reader as I love the feeling of accomplishment when logging activities in my reading journal. I read digital, physical, and audio books and the variety offered in how to track your reading is phenomenal.

Great app for keeping track of your books (read and to be read). The trackers are helping me increase how much I read in a year. I've learned about more books through the app that I don't think I would've heard about otherwise. The summaries and reviews are really helpful when looking for new books to read.

My fav book tracker app! I've been a faithful user of Storygraph since '23 after transferring from Good Reads. My favorite features are the reading stats and book challenges that encourage me to read outside my normal genre. Not to mention you'll be supporting an independent, black woman-owned reading business! I would highly recommend Storygraph!

I've used this as my reading tracking app for YEARS. I love the many visuals, showing how many books I've read in a year (you can also compare years), see how many books each month you've read, pages, write reviews, all sorts of fun stuff. AND giveaways you can sign up for a chance to win.

Been a storygraph user for over a year now and upgraded to the paid version almost straight away. Thoroughly enjoyed the big buddy read for project Hail Mary but do wish the book clubs feature was more well known, as most of my clubs are on another app. Storygraph is perfect for tracking reading!
reviews.reply: We will make the book club feature more well known for sure! Thank you for your review and rating. :-D

Storygraph is a wonderful app! I used to have Goodreads and Fable as well but now I only use Storygraph. I enjoy the different charts and trackers that give me feedback on what I've been reading. a great way to track reading stats

athis is the best book app I've ever used. Its simple and easy to engage with, and I love how it's not overwhelming to look at.

The best app there is for tracking your books read! So many different data points available, plus leaving personal notes related to each book are my favorite features. Best book tracking app I've used! very intuitive features, and I love how reviews are broken down into themes rather than just stars. It's easy to track different editions (audio/print/digital). my absolute favourite feature is the monthly wrap up - you get so much cool data on your reading habits!

I love this app. It is so easy to use, and I love all the stats. Highly recommend!

reviews.reply: Hello. You have to hit "Update" for the settings to save. I added a second "Update" button up top but on mobile I realised recently this is still buried below all of the notification settings. I'm also going to be doing a lot of work on the UI and UX over the coming months.

reviews.text: Nunca dejó importar el archivo desde goodreads, y sin haberse modificado o incluso abierto
reviews.reply: Goodreads changed the format of their export file yesterday. We've since updated our importer so it'll work now.

reviews.text: Uninstalled this immediately as soon as the advanced configuration options at setup revealed that the app is running your reading requests through an LLM. Explicit instructions are given to not mention anything you want to avoid, a shortcoming of LLM models. Algorithms are fundamental to a product like this, but I'm not going to let this thing just soullessly spit out recommendations I can just use a Google search for. Hard pass. Try harder.
reviews.reply: Our machine learning recommendations algorithm was created in-house in 2019. It is completely local and we don't share data with or use any third party. Other apps use machine learning to generate recommendations. By giving you the ability to type in specific themes, topics, and tropes we're aiming to unlock far more personalised recommendations.

reviews.text: I typed "perfection" to search for the book with the title and I have to scroll through hundreds of romances and smuts that contain the word "perfect" in their titles to finally find the actual book. This is the second biggest book website??
reviews.reply: Hi Allen. I need to work on the search algorithm, but if you put it at least a little bit of the author's name, what you're looking for will come up top.

reviews.text: I tried Goodreads, Fable and Storygraph. I can say that Storygraph is the winner. The promotional content from Fable is too much and Goodreads is just not got for stats. reviews.text: Really useful app, it motivates me to read every day to keep up my streak. I contacted customer service about a broken streak a few months ago and the response was really sympathetic and helpful, the best app of it's kind and I really enjoy the graphs and breakdowns of my reading style.
Such a cute and user-friendly app! I really like the breakdowns of book genres and themes you've read, that you can filter through. I hope more users come to it, it's absolutely worth a download.

Simple to use app and I like being able to track where I am in a book and see the percent complete. I have noticed tho that some books total page count is much higher than the actual story because the app is including bibliography, acknowledgements, and sometimes even sample chapters from other books by the author. Overall I enjoy the app.
reviews.reply: Hi Alexandra. Thank you for your review and rating. You can adjust your journal entries after reading the book if you think your read page count is inflated. Email us at support@thestorygraph.com for more info on how to do this.

reviews.text: I started using this app in January and its honestly the best when it comes to stats and tracking. The UI is simple and easy to use. My favorite feature so far is the monthly wrap-up graphics which i can share or save.
